issue_context.title: Surepetcare integration fails to create binary sensor for door state
issue_context.body:
### The problem

When adding the Suerepetcare integration (via YAML), it fails to create a sensor notifying of the door state e.g.
`sensor.pet_flap_laundry_door`

This was present under the sureha integration and working although recent updates to that version broke the service call hence the attempted switch to the mainline version.

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2021.9.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

?

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Sure Petcare 

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/surepetcare/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
surepetcare:
  username: YOUR_SURE_PETCARE_LOGIN
  password: YOUR_SURE_PETCARE_PASSWORD
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_

review_comments:
The is for a cat flap, where only registered cats (with chips) are allowed to enter.
Learn mode is what you enable to register a new cat. 
Not sure how useful it is, but it was in the old integration.
Maybe it should be a separate binary sensor?
fyi: this mode is rarely used by a typical user, basically just a single time for each pet on the initial setup. So I think an own sensor for this isn't really needed.
Then it should be an entity that is disabled by default.
